Appearance Admire Groove is an Umamusume of slightly above average height with pale skin and ocean blue hair that fades into a dull color at the bottom. It is styled in a bob with longer strand at the front, with her side-swept bangs being streaked with white. Admire Groove has heterochromia, with her left eye being lilac and her right eye being a bright blue. Both of her eye colors fade into a light pink at the bottom. She also wears bright blue ear covers, with the left one sporting a golden ring and a navy ribbon, a navy headband, and a matching pom-pom accessory coupled with a ribbon that holds up a small braided section of her hair. Admire Groove's racing outfit consists of a frilly cyan dress with an asymmetrical skirt, a dark blue waistline and a red belt with a gold buckle. Below that, she wears navy shorts with gold accents. She also wears a floral black translucent lace top with feathery sleeves and a small red tie, and a royal blue sash with gold accents drapes from her right shoulder. Admire Groove also wears frilly black form-fitting sleeves accented with golden jewelry, dark translucent stockings, the right of which having a bright blue arrow pattern held up by gold garters, each embedded with a red gem as well as a pair of golden diamond-shaped anklets. Her shoes are white with chunky golden heels with red soles. Relationships Air Groove - A reliable senior and mentor. Air Groove watches out for Admire Groove and often worries for her wellbeing, making sure that she's alright. She shows great care for Admire Groove, despite Admire Groove's cold and withdrawn demeanor.
IRL, Admire Groove was foaled by Air Groove.[1] IRL, Admire Groove was foaled by Air Groove.[1] Rulership - Friend and classmate, introduced through Air Groove. They both get annoyed by each other, and Rulership hates it when Admire Groove finds her to be a nuisance. However, Air Groove encourages both of them to get along with each other and not bicker. On occasion, Rulership asks Admire Groove to play games with her and help her with studying.
IRL, Admire Groove is Rulership's older half-sister. Currently, in Umamusume, it is not confirmed whether or not Admire Groove and Rulership are biologically related due to Admire Groove being an orphan. IRL, Admire Groove is Rulership's older half-sister. Currently, in Umamusume, it is not confirmed whether or not Admire Groove and Rulership are biologically related due to Admire Groove being an orphan. Still in Love - Rival. Still in Love's "alter ego" is especially fired up about racing with her, going as far as to chase after her and call her "her prey." The two are shown to be opposites; while Still in Love is full of warmth and love, Admire Groove rejects love and mentions being "cold" inside. Despite Admire Groove being the favorite in all three Triple Tiara races, it's Still in Love who wins them. Admire Groove is visibly upset about losing to Still in Love, which makes Still in Love wonder why Admire Groove dislikes her so much. Still in Love seems to respect Admire Groove a lot, especially after witnessing how many people cheer her on and root for her.
IRL, They are 2 prolific rivals throughout the 2003 Classic Season, and across their careers, they raced each other 9 times. Notable, Admire Groove lost all three legs of the Triple Tiara to Still in Love despite being the favorite. Admire Groove gets annoyed when Red Desire prays for her before they go to sleep. Despite Admire Groove's personality, Red Desire believes that she's a nice girl deep down. Duramente - Friend and underclassman. Admiring her strength, Duramente gets taken under her wing. Meanwhile, Admire Groove feels oddly familiar when around Duramente, and watches her races in support.
IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. IRL, Admire Groove is the dam of Duramente. Sweep Tosho - Underclassman and rival. Sweep wants to challenge Admire Groove, while Admire Groove is unbothered by her.

Neo Universe notices that despite Admire Groove's behavior, she's actually really perceptive of other people, like how she notices Still. She also shows great concern for her, as her universal knowledge of her past as a horse lets her understand what Admire Groove is going through.

Trivia She was announced during the PakaLive TV Vol.56 stream on August 22nd, 2025. In the game, other characters call her "Aruvu" (アルヴ), similarly to Admire Vega's nickname "Ayabe". Like Admire Vega, Admire Groove had different nicknames in real life, like "Adoguru" (アドグル) by fans and "Gurumi" (グル美) by her stablehands. Admire Groove grew up in an orphanage and has no memory of her parents. Admire Groove being an orphan is likely a reference to how Air Groove's owner and trainer, Satoshi Yoshihara and Yuji Ito, were unable to purchase Admire Groove due to her high price.[3] Her unique skill animation features the same flower garden from Still in Love's unique skill animation, further cementing their rivalry. During her career mode, an event in her senior year shows her suddenly collapsing as she tries to attend Duramente's race. She feels as though something is compelling her not to go.[4]
This is a reference to how Admire Groove died shortly after having Duramente in real life. This is a reference to how Admire Groove died shortly after having Duramente in real life. She is very good at first aid.[5] Her favorite story is The Snow Queen, a Danish fairy tale written by Hans Christian Andersen. This story is the inspiration for her racewear.[6] She likes books about nature and animals.[7] She secretly likes to pet cute animals, such as dogs.[8]  Her love for dogs is likely a nod to Air Groove, as Air Groove also likes dogs in Umamusume. She finds music cafes relaxing.[9] She also secretly likes listening to nostalgic songs from when she was younger.[10] As a reference to how Air Groove is her dam in real life, Admire Groove's racewear has a feather pattern on her right shoulder. Admire Groove's poor temper and standoffish personality is based on how Mitsura Hashida described her as the most sensitive horse he ever trained.[11] Student Introduction  Continue
